description: LADOT Parking Calendar Sign Locations is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Citywide locations with new calendar-style parking signs installed or coming soon. Updated as needed. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are meter, parking, parking meter, map, sign. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: LADOT Parking Meters Division. The portal shows 2019-09-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
